Source.Name: perl-scalar-list-utils
Source.Summary: Scalar::Util, List::Util and Sub::Util perl modules
Source.Description: This package contains a selection of subroutines that people have expressed would be nice to have in the perl core, but the usage would not really be high enough to warrant the use of a keyword, and the size so small such that being individual extensions would be wasteful.
